name.ja: Figure-rise Standard Amplified -三幻神降臨- オベリスクの巨神兵
name.en: Figure-rise Standard Amplified -Three Genshins Advent- Giant God Soldier of the Obelisk

description.ja: キャラクターの魅力をオリジナルアレンジで“増幅”！『遊☆戯☆王デュエルモンスターズ』より、三幻神の一体「オベリスクの巨神兵」がAmplifiedに降臨！！
description.en: “Amplify” the charm of the characters with original arrangements! From "Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters ", one of the three phantom gods, " Obelisk Giant Soldier", has arrived in Amplified! !

description.ja: ■特徴的な技の「ゴッド・ハンド・クラッシャー」モードをAmplified解釈で表現。■胸部、肩部、腕部、翼に展開ギミックを搭載。翼膜のディテールは緻密なモールドで表現。■額の宝玉や歯などを洗練されたパーツ分割で表現。■脚部の可動で膝立ちのポーズも可能。■全高約235mm。迫力のボリューム感で圧倒的存在感を表現。
description.en: • Expressing the characteristic technique "God Hand Crusher" mode with an amplified interpretation. • Equipped with deployment gimmicks on the chest, shoulders, arms, and wings. The details of the wing membrane are expressed with a precise mold. • Represent the jewels on the forehead, teeth, etc. with sophisticated parts division. • The legs are movable, allowing for kneeling poses. • Overall height approximately 235mm. Expressing an overwhelming presence with a powerful sense of volume.
